title: Critical Early Moments: Foundations of Development and Growth from Birth to Age Three
description: A developmental pathway covering the most important principles of early development: sensory and motor sensitivities, attachment theory, Piaget’s sensorimotor stages, and the significance of parental responsiveness in building cognitive and emotional foundations. Based on UNICEF’s 'Early Moments Matter' report and CDC’s Act Early guidelines.
